compile_params._comment: sample_freq/bandpass_filter/pre_event_seconds/post_event_seconds here MUST match config.json's preprocess_params — that's how the compiled cache filename is derived on both the write side (this script) and the read side (IO/dataset.py). A mismatch just misses the cache with a clear FileNotFoundError, never silently reads stale data.
compile_params._pre_post_comment: Global — injected into every loader's dataset_params uniformly (see cache_dataset.py), same mechanism dataset_path already uses. Only the trigger/annotation-anchored loaders read them (BCICIV1_Train, BNCI2014001, BNCI2014004, Inria_Train); everyone else's loader ignores them (see e.g. datas/PhysionetMI/loader.py, which deliberately opts out even though it receives them — real headroom there is ~0, see docs/model-analysis-checklist.md). Total window = pre+post = 5.0s = 1000 samples @ 200Hz, must match config.json's preprocess_params.window_length.
